states.name: Andhra Pradesh
states.description: Andhra Pradesh is a state in southeastern India. It was formed in 1956 from the Telugu-speaking regions of Madras State. In 2014, Telangana was carved out as a separate state.
facts: Largest producer of rice in India
Home to Tirupati temple — most visited religious site
Coastline of 974 km along Bay of Bengal

historicalEvents.event: Andhra Pradesh formed from Madras State
Telangana carved out as separate state

states.name: Maharashtra
states.description: Maharashtra is India's second-most populous state and third-largest by area. It was formed on May 1, 1960 when Bombay State was divided along linguistic lines.
facts: Ajanta and Ellora Caves — UNESCO World Heritage Sites

states.name: Tamil Nadu
states.description: Tamil Nadu is a state in southern India. It has one of the oldest civilizations in the world with a rich cultural heritage spanning over 2000 years.
facts: Tamil is one of the world's oldest classical languages
Highest literacy rate in South India

states.name: Karnataka
states.description: Karnataka is a state in southwestern India. It is known as the Silicon Valley of India due to its thriving IT industry in Bengaluru.
facts: Largest gold mine in Asia at Kolar

states.name: Rajasthan
states.description: Rajasthan is the largest state of India by area. It is known for its majestic forts, palaces, and the Thar Desert.
facts: Largest state by area in India
Thar Desert — largest desert in India

historicalEvents.event: Rajputana states merged to form Rajasthan

states.name: Madhya Pradesh
states.description: Madhya Pradesh is the second-largest state by area. Known as the 'Heart of India', it is home to numerous national parks and UNESCO heritage sites.
facts: Sanchi Stupa — oldest stone structure in India

states.name: Uttar Pradesh
states.description: Uttar Pradesh is the most populous state in India. It is home to the Taj Mahal and numerous religious sites along the Ganges river.
facts: Varanasi — oldest living city in the world

states.name: West Bengal
states.description: West Bengal is a state in eastern India. Kolkata was the capital of British India and remains a major cultural and intellectual hub.
facts: Kolkata — former capital of British India
Home to Nobel laureate Rabindranath Tagore

states.name: Gujarat
states.description: Gujarat is a state on the western coast of India. It is the birthplace of Mahatma Gandhi and is known for its vibrant culture and thriving economy.
facts: Gir Forest — only wild Asiatic lions
Major diamond cutting and polishing hub

states.name: Bihar
states.description: Bihar is one of the oldest inhabited places in the world. It was the centre of the Maurya and Gupta empires and the birthplace of Buddhism.

states.name: Odisha
states.description: Odisha is a state on the eastern coast of India. It is known for its ancient temples, tribal culture, and the Konark Sun Temple.
facts: Chilika Lake — largest coastal lagoon in Asia

states.name: Telangana
states.description: Telangana is India's youngest state, carved out of Andhra Pradesh in 2014. Hyderabad is a major IT hub and historical city.

states.name: Kerala
states.description: Kerala is a state on the southwestern Malabar Coast. Known as 'God's Own Country', it has the highest literacy rate in India.

states.name: Punjab
states.description: Punjab is a state in northwestern India. Known as the 'Granary of India', it was partitioned in 1947 between India and Pakistan.
facts: Highest per capita income in India

historicalEvents.event: Punjab partitioned between India and Pakistan
Haryana and Himachal Pradesh carved out

states.name: Haryana
states.description: Haryana is a state in northern India. It surrounds Delhi on three sides and is one of the wealthiest states per capita.
facts: Highest per capita income in North India

states.name: Himachal Pradesh
states.description: Himachal Pradesh is a state in the Western Himalayas. Known for its scenic beauty, it is a major tourist destination.
facts: Summer capital of British India — Shimla

states.name: Uttarakhand
states.description: Uttarakhand is a state in the Himalayas. Known as 'Devbhoomi' (Land of Gods), it is home to many Hindu pilgrimage sites.
facts: Source of Ganges and Yamuna rivers
Jim Corbett — first national park in India

historicalEvents.event: Uttarakhand carved out of Uttar Pradesh

states.name: Jharkhand
states.description: Jharkhand is a state in eastern India. Rich in mineral resources, it is known as the 'Mineral Bowl of India'.

states.name: Chhattisgarh
states.description: Chhattisgarh is a state in central India. Known as the 'Rice Bowl of Central India', it has rich tribal culture and dense forests.

historicalEvents.event: Chhattisgarh carved out of Madhya Pradesh

states.name: Assam
states.description: Assam is a state in northeastern India. Known for its tea gardens, silk, and the one-horned rhinoceros.

states.name: Arunachal Pradesh
states.description: Arunachal Pradesh is the easternmost state of India. Known as the 'Land of the Rising Sun', it borders China, Bhutan, and Myanmar.

states.name: Nagaland
states.description: Nagaland is a state in northeastern India. Known for its warrior tribes and the Hornbill Festival.
facts: Battle of Kohima — WWII turning point

states.name: Manipur
states.description: Manipur is a state in northeastern India. Known as the 'Jewel of India', it is famous for its classical dance form Manipuri.
facts: Loktak Lake — largest freshwater lake in NE India

states.name: Meghalaya
states.description: Meghalaya is a state in northeastern India. Known as the 'Abode of Clouds', it receives the highest rainfall in the world.

states.name: Mizoram
states.description: Mizoram is a state in northeastern India. Known for its high literacy rate and peaceful society.
facts: Second highest literacy rate in India

states.name: Tripura
states.description: Tripura is a state in northeastern India. It is surrounded by Bangladesh on three sides and is known for its ancient temples.

states.name: Sikkim
states.description: Sikkim is a landlocked state in the Himalayas. It was an independent kingdom until 1975 when it merged with India.

historicalEvents.event: Sikkim merges with India as 22nd state

states.name: Goa
states.description: Goa is the smallest state by area. A former Portuguese colony, it is known for its beaches, churches, and vibrant culture.
facts: Basilica of Bom Jesus — UNESCO Heritage
Highest per capita income in India
